question: Can the captured block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3 responses be installed without the upstream writer to execute its causal effect?

frozen_design.population: all fresh A1 and A2 rows
frozen_design.capture: capture native base block9/block11 head outputs and their live responses to the exact block8H1 cue writer
frozen_design.program: without the writer, add captured changed-minus-base responses at block9 H1/H4, block11 H3, or both in causal order
frozen_design.destinations: final query only for both reader responses

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_respon: capture identity and attention reconstruction errors <=5e-4; base identity scored-logit error <=1e-4
predictions.pred_b_writer_recurrence: writer effect recurs within 0.03 of 0.17216 A1 and 0.11321 A2, donorward on every row
predictions.pred_c_each_installed_reader_is_material: each reader alone installs >=0.25 and <=0.75 of writer recovery in both families
predictions.pred_d_joint_response_program_is_suffici: both installed responses recover [0.75,1.25] of writer effect with donorward fraction >=0.75 in both families
predictions.pred_e_unselected_head_response_is_inert: installing all other block9/block11 head responses has absolute recovery <=0.15 of writer in both families
predictions.pred_f_exact_zero_fit_price: 24 forwards, 768 examples, 384 unique arm-row records, zero fits/backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, reconstruction, identity, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.mediation_only: A/B/C/E/F pass but joint installation is not sufficient
terminal_rules.null: valid writer recurrence but one or both captured reader responses are not independently material

interpretation_limits: This program reuses row-matched captured responses and is an extraction screen, not yet a compressed general predictor.
A pass licenses fresh-corpus response prediction and literal program pricing; it does not by itself establish those.
A miss records removal/insertion asymmetry rather than reopening the already valid joint-clamp mediation.
